 JUDGMENT
Since these appeals are arising out of same accident and common judgment and award, they are clubbed together and disposed of by a common judgment.
2. These appeals are filed by injured seeking enhancement of the compensation granted in respect of the motor vehicle accident dated 17.06.2018.
C/W MFA No.200008 of 2021 AND 3. For the sake of convenience the parties are referred to by their rank before the Tribunal.

4. It is the case of the petitioners that on 17.06.2018 at Shahapur, they loaded Hallow blocks in tractor trailer bearing registration No.KA-36/TB-8937 (tractor trailer' for short) for construction of cow shed and were proceeding towards Hattigudur.

At 11-15 a.m., near Rastapur village on Shahapur-Hattigudur road, a Tipper bearing registration No.KA-33/A-4395 ('the offending vehicle'
for short), came from the opposite side, in a high speed, in a rash or negligent manner and dashed against Tractor Trailer.
In the said accident, the petitioners and others sustained grievous injuries resulting in permanent partial disability.
Despite prolonged treatment, they are not completely cured.
As the owner and insurer, respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.
